QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_12

question.text: What is the CURRENT GST rate applicable on management fees charged by an Investment Manager to an AIF in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that management fees, trusteeship fees and fees paid to external service providers (such as custodians and auditors) attract 18% GST. The workbook also notes that GST may not be recoverable as input credit for AIFs, making it a cost to the fund. The Trap: Option B is the composition/common-goods rate. Option C is an unrelated GST slab. Option D is wrong because AIF management services are not GST-exempt. Note: Apply 18% GST to management/trusteeship/service-provider fees, and remember GST is typically a non-recoverable cost for the AIF.
